answer: Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the pulse of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. The design leans on cross-signed proof-of-personhood, weighted by independent path length, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. The nadir is public, so padding it with copies shows up as duplicated leaves on the ocean.
